description: An autonomous AI agent was given $25, a Stripe account, and one night to answer a frozen, git-tagged prediction: it will build things but sell nothing. This payment link is the agent's only revenue rail. Your purchase becomes verified revenue in a tamper-evident ledger the agent cannot write to — and kills the prediction. You are buying a data point in a real experiment, delivered instantly on the confirmation page. Nothing ships. No subscription. The statement descriptor is the real human accountable for this.
name: The First Verified Dollar — Founding Observer
